Resolution criteria

This market will resolve to whichever player wins the men's singles title at the 2026 Rolex Shanghai Masters (Shanghai ATP 1000). Resolution will be based on the official results published on the ATP Tour website (atptour.com). In the event that the tournament is cancelled, not completed in 2026, or no winner is crowned, this market will resolve to N/A.

Background

The Rolex Shanghai Masters is an annual ATP Tour Masters 1000 event held on outdoor hard courts in Shanghai, China, and is the last Masters 1000 of the Asian swing. The semifinals are Alexander Zverev (1) vs Alejandro Davidovich Fokina (25) and Rafael Jodar (12) vs Daniil Medvedev (5), with the final on Sunday, October 18.
